checks.note: handle()'s try block visibly skips paymentGateway.transferToCoach when toTransfer.signum() == 0 and commits RELEASED with stripeTransferId = null, matching the described mechanics; but confirming the double-count requires StripePaymentGateway.findExistingTransfer (guard located only inside transferToCoach?), CoachPayoutDebtService.planOffset/recordDebt (can debt >= net appear between drives?), and the absence of a reconciliation job — none of which are in the provided file, and the session's file tools are disabled so the verification caveat could not be run.

This file confirms the setup: upsertCoachStripeAccount stamps lastEventCreatedAt with a raw truncated server-clock connectedAt (no skew pad, unlike pollSnapshotTime), and getStripeStatus/resyncCompleteAccounts skip deauthorized rows, so a wrong sentinel wouldn't heal. But the decisive staleness comparison lives in handleAccountDeauthorized/applyDeauthorization (CoachStripeAccountStatusApplier / webhook handler), which is not shown — whether an event with created == or > the marker is accepted, and any other guards there, cannot be checked; production clock-skew is also runtime state.

In-file mechanics confirmed: handleConnectEventAtomically commits the insertIfAbsent dedup row even when handleAccountDeauthorized's ifPresentOrElse else-branch (log-only, STRIPE_ACCOUNT_DEAUTHORIZED_UNKNOWN) matches no account, so redeliveries are dropped as duplicates. But the finding's required verification — that CoachStripeAccountStatusApplier.applyDeauthorization is the sole setter of TRANSFERS_DEAUTHORIZED, that no sweeper re-processes stripe_webhook_events, and the transferReadiness/outbox consequences — depends on code outside this file, which was not provided.

upsertCoachStripeAccount (StripeOnboardingService.java, findById(coachId) branch) indeed has no guard against another coach row holding the same stripeAccountId, and handleOAuthCallback does consume the OAuth code before persisting; but the finding hinges on the V138 unique index idx_csa_stripe_account_id and on whether fk_csa_coach cascades on coach re-registration, neither of which (migration, entity, FK DDL) is in the provided file.

handle() holds findByIdForUpdate's PESSIMISTIC_WRITE, the FOR SHARE freeze lock, and the debt-row locks across the synchronous paymentGateway.transferToCoach call inside one REQUIRES_NEW transaction, and its own EC-4 comment confirms DisputeService.reconcileCoachPayout contends for the same row lock. Exact Stripe timeouts (StripeClient/PaymentConfig) are not in this file, but that only affects stall duration, not the mechanism.
